decisions.summary: A caption declares its text and subject (group membership or data-names ids). A one-time migration strips its x/y and hand leader from the tracked sheet and writes the ids from today's subject reading.
decisions.why: This is the proposal the GM accepted ('a sheet declaring only a caption's text and what it names') and FR-002 ('nothing that decides where it stands'). The migration reads position once, only so that no caption changes what it names. Placement never depends on it afterwards. Unchanged since round 1.

decisions.summary: Inside or beside is the placer's call: inside seats first, then the ranked beside seats. Done in seat_label as two place() calls.
decisions.why: FR-002: the placer decides inside or beside from the drawing, and the sheet declares neither. Unchanged since round 1.

decisions.summary: The extended fallback (a whole-extent inside sample, slid point positions, a per-block search on stepped buildings) goes in labels/placer.py and is shared with the generated maps. It runs only when the standard search finds no free seat, and it is measured on the scripted maps.
decisions.why: The accepted proposal ('improve the placer's fallback'), the GM's 'reuse the same literal code', FR-003 ('improved in the placer itself') and the Assumptions all call for this. Unchanged since round 1.

decisions.summary: Mixed-size captions are measured and written line by line, at each line's own size.
decisions.why: FR-003: two of the eight measured misses have this cause. Any effect on the generated maps is covered by D9's before-and-after comparison. Unchanged since round 1.

decisions.summary: seat_label.placed() in each hand sheet's gen renders the PNG and the page from the placed text. make sheet-render renders any sheet placed.
decisions.why: FR-001: placing is a step of the pipeline and there is no separate tool to run. sheet-render is that same pipeline, offered to readers. Unchanged since round 1.

decisions.summary: Removes test_hand_sheet_captions.py, the caption ledger, make seat-label and its judge report, the four sheet-audit checks with their red fixtures and tests, the label half of trees_overlap, and building-review's caption-seat step. The tree's checks against the hand-drawn things stay.
decisions.why: The round 1 finding is resolved. The label half of trees_overlap (shared.py:410, the plan.labels line in _things_under_a_tree) is now on the removal list, and the stated reason matches the GM's ('There is no point in having an automated check run against an automated process'). What stays is a canopy against buildings, fences, wells, glyphs and tubs. Those are drawn by hand, and FR-004 keeps checks of things still drawn by hand. The rest of trees_overlap (walls, dividers, furniture, the duplicate-tree rule) is not named in the parenthetical, but D6 removes only what it lists, so it stays too. Every other sheet-audit reader of label positions was re-checked: occluded_foreground, orphan_group_labels, dark_on_dark_labels and overlapping_labels are on the list. labels.py pairing and the notice-board fallback are FR-005 readers, and D7 covers them. shared.py:87 reads text only. Every check of caption placement is now removed, so the list narrows nothing.

decisions.summary: pack_audit/labels.py pairs items with structures by data-kind tags. Any other reader of caption coordinates moves to the placed text or the tags.
decisions.why: FR-005. Since the label half of trees_overlap is now removed under D6, the phrase 'moved to the placed text' can no longer keep a placement check alive.

decisions.summary: SKILL.md Mode A usage, buildings.md, research presentation 040's note that names make seat-label, and the building-review and size-audit contracts: a sheet declares text and subject, the pipeline places it, and the contracts judge wording, not position.
decisions.why: FR-006. The round 1 aside (presentation 040 names make seat-label) is now in the list. docs/make-targets.html also lists make seat-label, but that page is generated from the Makefile and make-docs.py --check gates it, so removing the target under D6 removes its row as well.

decisions.summary: make quick; the one-time SC-002 measurement in measurements.json; the scripted maps' captions compared before and after D3; make done; the blind test at hand-back, with the 18 legacy exhibits named as untouched.
decisions.why: SC-002 as a one-time measurement and not a standing check; XIII verification of a change to shared code; the hand-back line the round-2 MODE 1 ruling required. Unchanged since round 1.
